load_sonata_data: load sonata dataset from HuggingFace by name or from a local npz file path
collate_point_cloud_batch: collate a batch of point cloud samples into stacked tensors with offset arrays
load_sample1_dataset: load the sample1 sonata dataset from HuggingFace into a dictionary of numpy arrays
collate_dict_point_clouds: collate a batch of point cloud dicts with coord keys into a single batched dict
collate_tensor_batch: collate a batch of point cloud tensors into a single concatenated tensor
